newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - July 8.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - July 8.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Tuesday:
* Philippine stocks are likely to fall due to jitters over a renewed attack on the peso, analysts said.
"I see negative sentiment because of the renewed pressure on the peso," said analyst Chemarie Cheng of Dharmala Securities Philippines Inc.

* But analysts said they expected the Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co to mimic its $1 1/2 rise overnight in New York due to speculation that it would rake in more revenue in case the peso weakens.
* Sun Hung Kai Securities said it expected the index to test the 2,700 psychological support in the coming days as investors are more likely to remain defensive.
* BPI Securities said the market would also keep a close watch on first half corporate earnings reports which are expected to start this month.

"Although our projections of corporate performances are mixed, we feel big cap companies must show good first half corporate performances and better prospects for the year if the market is to make a rally by the third quarter."
